Using a typical budget for level 42. Set your gold
Zones for Ref Hunter 42

Ranked by skill-ups first, then by the prices you've entered and today's conditions. Only zones up to level 44 are included. Tap a zone for when, where and why.

1. Feralas
40–50
Heavy Leather, Heavy Hide, Turtle Scale, Thick Leather, Thick Hide
WHEN
Now. Level 40–50 fits you, so you can quest here while you gather.
Skinning skill-ups from Turtle Scale, Thick Leather and Thick Hide until about 225 (you're at 205).
Weekends bring more farmers; weekday evenings are calmer.
Sell what you gather at Tue 7 PM (Heavy Leather +12% vs now).
WHERE
Kalimdor, contested territory: watch for the other faction on PvP realms.
Skin Longtooth Runners and Howlers, Ironfur Bears and Groddoc Thunderers (about level 40–45) around The Twin Colossals, Ruins of Isildien and Lower Wilds for Thick and Rugged Leather. Good skill-ups for you.
WHY
3 node types still give skill-ups.
Thick Leather is worth about 23s 14c each today, roughly 8g 24s an hour if you gathered only that.
Today's conditions push Heavy Leather, Heavy Hide and Turtle Scale up.
